title.zh: BioAIEvolu 的 DSH 插件合集

description.en: Find-in-page search and session tools for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的页内查找与会话工具。

description.en: Find-in-page search for DeepSeek Harness: locate text across conversation, sidebar and right panel with Ctrl+F, Chinese/English literal matching, highlight navigation, draggable panel with position memory, adaptive width, theme-aware colors, copy full message, and composer history recall.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 页内查找：Ctrl+F 定位对话、侧栏与右栏的可见文本，中英文字面匹配，高亮导航，面板可拖拽并记忆位置，宽度随输入自适应，颜色跟随主题，复制整条消息，输入框历史取回。
